description: This file defines a MedicalRecordService class that provides methods to interact with a 'medical_records' database table, including listing records for a patient, retrieving by ID, creating new records, and deleting records.

classes.name: MedicalRecordService
classes.description: A service class for managing medical records via database interactions.

methods.name: listForPatient
methods.description: Fetches list of medical records for a specific patient ID, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single medical record by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new medical record entry in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a medical record by its ID.
